description: This file defines a React functional component 'ReportsPage' that displays a list of user reports. It fetches report data from an API upon component mount, manages loading state, and renders a list of reports with options to create a new report or open existing ones. It also wraps the content with an 'AuthGuard' component to enforce authentication.

methods.name: ReportsPage
methods.description: Main React component that fetches and displays a list of reports, handling loading state and user interactions.
